t: The 4lite Torre Single 5ft LED Batten provides efficient and versatile lighting for various professional environments. This slimline polycarbonate LED light features adjustable wattage, allowing selection between 25W and 50W output, alongside a choice of three colour temperatures (3000K, 4000K, 5700K). It is ideal for commercial premises, industrial units, or workshops requiring adaptable and bright illumination. Installation is made simple and fast with integrated push-fit terminals and BESA fixing points, ensuring secure ceiling or wall mounting. This robust LED batten delivers impressive energy efficiency, offering up to 140 lumens per watt.
b: 5 Year Manufacturer’s Guarantee (Registration Required, T&Cs Apply)
